notes.title: Captain Soda is shooting its way to PC, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox this year!
notes.content:
Fellow captains!

We are pleased to announce Ray Flower Games is teaming up with indie game publisher Leoful to bring Captain Soda to PC, Nintendo Switch™, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One in 2024!

To celebrate, we have a few pieces of news to share with you today!

1. Watch the new announcement trailer

Have a taste of the carbonated action in the latest announcement trailer below!

[previewyoutube=Y8U-QCyOSi4;full][/previewyoutube]

2. Play the Captain Soda demo and tell us your thoughts

The latest version of the Captain Soda demo is now available to play! It gives you access to three levels from the full version of the game and a small taste of Endless mode. 

Tell us your thoughts about the demo on the discussion forums or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FG2rC6gH93C]Discord[/url].

While the current version of the demo supports English, we are planning to add support for more languages in the future, so please stay tuned!

3. Take part in the Captain Soda demo competition

The Captain Soda demo competition will be held from now to the end of Steam Next Fest: February 2024 Edition (February 12, 2024 10am Pacific Time).

The top 3 players in each Endless mode leaderboard (up to a total of 15 players) will win a free key for the full game that will be sent to you at launch!

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EduahD7xdeHfP2JlYkdJvjjahbN43TbG7QKSR81tR-c/edit]Click here[/url] to read the full contest rules.

4. Upcoming Kickstarter page

We will be kicking off a Kickstarter campaign for Captain Soda later this year, and there will be some fancy digital and physical rewards up for grabs. Stay tuned for more details by [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/leoful/captain-soda/]following the Kickstarter preview page[/url].

Ray Flower Games and Leoful

notes.title: Big Update: New Endless Mode!
notes.content:
Hey ( •̀ ω •́ )✧

I've been working away on a new game mode and wanted to share more on it today. A new endless rogue-lite mode has been added to the game. This will have limited availability in the demo, but you can still try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41853772/73585315b4f880bdcdfb11e87aeea1ddaf065764.png[/img]

--- New feature: Endless mode
- Clear endless randomly generated levels in an arcade rogue-like game mode!
- Levels reuse existing campaign mode levels but with entirely generated waves
- Choose a soda hero to play for the run
- Swap weapons by picking up new weapons in the level
- Acquire character upgrades for the run by leveling up through collecting money
- Don't like an upgrade? reroll it!
- Get score bonuses for taking no damage or beating the level quickly
- Endless mode uses separate save files from campaign mode
- Soda Hero unlock challenges
- High scores are recorded into leaderboards: Global and by soda hero
- Unlock more weapons and upgrades in runs with accumulating score over runs

If you have ideas or feedback for endless mode please share them here or on the Discord!

Cole
